note_on_binary_harm: H1a/H1c are discrete by construction; a rank correlation against a discrete indicator is a rank-biserial association and is reported as such, not as evidence of a continuous functional form
honesty_clause: if MECHANISM_NOT_SUPPORTED or MECHANISM_GAP_PERSISTS, the report must state that the composition account is NOT established by this diagnostic and must not be used to explain the P2-C1 amplification; the P2-C1 numbers stand either way, since they are confirmatory and independent of this file

bootstrap.convention: frozen: image-cluster sampler, replicates/seed/ci from core
bootstrap.deviation: replicate loop is local because phase0a.paired_cluster_bootstrap is hard-wired to metric(a)-metric(b) over two prediction sets
bootstrap.estimator: the replicate resamples images and re-runs the point functional (mean over B3 seeds of the within-family per-seed Spearman rho)

out_of_scope_confirmed: any C4 / hard-regime statement about GDINO (the B0 probe failed the same-category supply gate at 0.6892 vs 0.85; GDINO stays C1-only by user authorisation)
any claim that one detector is better than another
any causal language: this diagnostic is associational within family and stratified across families
any new model, feature, threshold, seed or dataset
